_note: Prices are USD per million tokens, checked against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-11-18 (the page shows no 'last updated' date). price_table_version is stamped on every cost event. Cache reads are 0.05x input on Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5; cache writes: 5-minute 1.25x, 1-hour 2x input. Haiku 5.5 is tiered: prompts over 100,000 tokens (all input incl. cache reads/writes) use the long_context prices. Default model for every role is claude-opus-5-5; switching bulk roles to a cheaper model is Archie's decision (see docs/decisions.md).

gemini-4-hydrogen.note: Google Gemini Developer API, paid tier, Standard (not Batch), per 1M tokens: input $1.50, output $7.50 (output INCLUDES thinking tokens), context caching $0.075 (implicit only). The page now redirects to aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing and shows no last-updated date.

website_extractor._note: Which model the website extractor uses. All agent roles stay on Claude (roles above). To try Gemini 4 Hydrogen set model to "gemini-4-hydrogen" (needs GEMINI_API_KEY); a Hydrogen call that errors or returns invalid JSON is retried once, then the page falls back to fallback_model. Every attempt is metered.
